claims.text: Jollof rice is a West African dish of rice cooked in a spiced tomato sauce.
Jollof rice is not a traditional dish of East Africa, the Caribbean or South Asia.
Nigeria, Ghana and Senegal, among other West African countries, each have their own versions of jollof rice.
The friendly rivalry between Nigerians and Ghanaians over whose jollof is better is popularly called the jollof wars.
